add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__)

spec2def(dxdiagn.dll dxdiagn.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(dxdiagn registry dxdiagn.idl)

# dxdiagn.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dxdiagn-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(dxdiagn_shims OBJECT container.c dxdiag_main.c provider.c)
target_link_libraries(dxdiagn_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload strmiids dxguid uuid oldnames libd3d9 libddraw libdsound libversion libole32 liboleaut32 libuser32 libadvapi32 libpsapi libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(dxdiagn_shims)
add_dependencies(dxdiagn_shims wineheaders)
set(DXDIAGN_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dxdiagn/dxdiagn_r.o)
add_cargo_module(dxdiagn dxdiagn-cargo dxdiagn.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dxdiagn_shims psdk dxdiagn_r ${DXDIAGN_REUSED} uuid_sources)
